description: Control Ableton Live from the terminal by track and device name, with backups for note edits and a journal of every change.

tools.name: arrangement_add-clip
tools.description: Create an empty MIDI clip on the Arrangement timeline (needs AbletonPPExtras). Required: track, at. Optional: bars (default: 4). Returns the new ArrangementClip.

params.name: at
params.description: Start position as beats (32) or bar.beat (9.1)

tools.name: arrangement_clips
tools.description: List a track's Arrangement clips with start, end and bar.beat positions. Required: track. Returns array of ArrangementClip.

tools.name: arrangement_delete-clip
tools.description: Delete an Arrangement clip (needs AbletonPPExtras). Required: track, clip. Returns the Ack. Destructive.

tools.name: automation_clear
tools.description: Clear a clip's automation envelope for a device parameter. Required: track, slot, device, param. Returns the Ack. Destructive.

tools.name: automation_get
tools.description: Read a clip's automation envelope for a device parameter. Required: track, slot, device, param. Optional: step (default: 0.25). Returns array of AutomationPoint.

tools.name: automation_set
tools.description: Write automation points into a clip's envelope from JSON. Required: track, slot, device, param, points. Returns the updated Ack.

params.name: points
params.description: Points to write: [{time, value, duration}] with time and duration in beats

tools.name: browser_index
tools.description: Every loadable browser item (two levels deep), for 'sync' and 'device add'. Returns array of BrowserItem.

tools.name: browser_list
tools.description: List the items inside a browser folder, e.g. instruments or drums/Kits. Required: path. Returns array of BrowserItem.

params.name: path
params.description: Browser path starting with a category, e.g. instruments, audio_effects or drums

tools.name: browser_tree
tools.description: Show the browser's top-level categories and their folders. Optional: category (default: all). Returns array of BrowserItem.

tools.name: clip_create
tools.description: Create an empty MIDI clip in a slot. Required: track, slot. Optional: bars (default: 4), name. Returns the new Clip.

tools.name: clip_delete
tools.description: Delete the clip in a slot. Required: track, slot. Returns the Ack. Destructive.

tools.name: clip_duplicate
tools.description: Copy a clip to an empty slot. Required: track, slot, to_slot. Optional: to_track. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: clip_duplicate-loop
tools.description: Double a clip's loop, copying its notes into the new half. Required: track, slot. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: clip_fire
tools.description: Launch a clip. Required: track, slot. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: clip_get
tools.description: Show all properties of a Session clip. Required: track, slot. Returns the Clip.

tools.name: clip_import-audio
tools.description: Create an audio clip from a local audio file (Live 12.0.5 or newer). Required: track, slot, file. Returns the new Ack.

params.name: file
params.description: Absolute path to a local .wav, .aif, .mp3 or .flac file (network paths are refused)

tools.name: clip_set
tools.description: Change one clip property (the change is journaled). Required: track, slot, prop, value. Returns the updated PropChange.

params.name: value
params.description: New value (number, on/off, or an enum name such as complex or 1/4)

tools.name: clip_stop
tools.description: Stop a playing clip. Required: track, slot. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: clip_to-arrangement
tools.description: Copy a Session clip onto the same track in the Arrangement at a position. Required: track, slot, at. Returns the new Ack.

params.name: at
params.description: Arrangement position as beats (32) or bar.beat (9.1)

tools.name: clips_grid
tools.description: Show every track's clip slots with clip names and lengths. Returns array of ClipSlot.

tools.name: device_delete
tools.description: Delete a device from a track (needs the AbletonPPExtras script). Required: track, device. Returns the Ack. Destructive.

tools.name: device_disable
tools.description: Turn a device off (bypass). Required: track, device. Returns the updated PropChange.

tools.name: device_enable
tools.description: Turn a device on. Required: track, device. Returns the updated PropChange.

tools.name: device_list
tools.description: List a track's devices with their type and class. Required: track. Returns array of Device.

tools.name: device_load
tools.description: Load an instrument, effect or plugin onto a track by its browser URI. Required: track, uri. Returns the new Ack.

params.name: uri
params.description: Browser URI from 'browser list' or 'browser tree', e.g. query:Synths#Drift

tools.name: drums_load
tools.description: Load a Drum Rack and a kit from the browser onto a track. Required: track, kit. Optional: rack_uri. Returns the new Ack.

params.name: kit
params.description: Kit path inside the browser's drums category, e.g. drums/Kit-Core 909

params.name: rack_uri
params.description: Drum Rack URI (default: Live's empty Drum Rack)

tools.name: drums_pads
tools.description: List a Drum Rack's filled pads (needs the AbletonPPExtras script). Required: track, device. Returns array of DrumPad.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check which Remote Scripts answer and their versions. Returns the Health.

tools.name: locator_add
tools.description: Add a named locator at a beat or bar.beat (renames an existing one at the same spot). Required: name, at. Returns the new Locator.

tools.name: locator_delete
tools.description: Delete a locator. Required: locator. Returns the Ack. Destructive.

tools.name: locator_jump
tools.description: Move the playhead to a locator, by name or number. Required: locator. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: locator_list
tools.description: List locators with their beat and bar.beat positions. Returns array of Locator.

tools.name: locator_next
tools.description: Jump to the next locator. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: locator_prev
tools.description: Jump to the previous locator. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: locator_rename
tools.description: Rename a locator. Required: locator, name. Returns the updated Locator.

tools.name: message_show
tools.description: Show a short message in Live's status bar. Required: text. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: midimap_cc
tools.description: Make a MIDI CC control a device parameter. Required: track, device, param, channel, cc. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: notes_add
tools.description: Add notes to a MIDI clip from JSON (keeps existing notes). Required: track, slot, notes. Returns the new Ack.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes to add: [{pitch, start, duration, velocity, mute}] with start and duration in beats

tools.name: notes_clear
tools.description: Remove notes from a MIDI clip, optionally only within a pitch and time range. Required: track, slot. Optional: pitch_from, pitch_to, time_from (plus 1 more). Returns the Ack. Destructive.

params.name: time_from
params.description: Start of the time range in beats (default 0)

params.name: time_to
params.description: End of the time range in beats (default: clip end)

tools.name: notes_get
tools.description: Read every note in a MIDI clip as JSON (pitch, start, duration, velocity, mute). Required: track, slot. Returns array of Note.

tools.name: param_list
tools.description: List a device's parameters with value, range and display text. Required: track, device. Returns array of Parameter.

tools.name: param_set
tools.description: Set a device parameter by name or number (range-checked and journaled). Required: track, device, param, value. Returns the updated PropChange.

params.name: value
params.description: New value within the parameter's min..max

tools.name: play_start
tools.description: Start Live's transport from the current position. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: rack_chains
tools.description: List a rack's chains with volume, pan, mute and solo (needs AbletonPPExtras). Required: track, device. Returns array of RackChain.

tools.name: rack_inspect
tools.description: Show a rack's nested devices and which macros are mapped. Required: track, device. Returns the RackInfo.

tools.name: rack_map-macro
tools.description: Map every nested device's Dry/Wet (or Mix/Amount) to Macro 1 and name it. Required: track, device. Optional: name (default: Magnitude). Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: record_capture
tools.description: Capture MIDI you just played into a new clip. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: record_session
tools.description: Turn Session record on or off. Required: on. Returns the updated PropChange.

params.name: on
params.description: true to arm Session record, false to disarm

tools.name: record_trigger
tools.description: Trigger Session record (like pressing the Session record button). Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: redo_last
tools.description: Redo the last undone operation. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: scene_create
tools.description: Create a scene. Optional: name, index. Returns the new Scene.

tools.name: scene_delete
tools.description: Delete a scene. Required: scene. Returns the Ack. Destructive.

tools.name: scene_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate a scene with its clips. Required: scene. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: scene_fire
tools.description: Launch a scene. Required: scene. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: scene_fire-selected
tools.description: Launch the selected scene and select the next one. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: scene_list
tools.description: List scenes with name, tempo, time signature and color. Returns array of Scene.

tools.name: scene_set
tools.description: Change a scene's name, color, tempo or time signature. Required: scene, prop, value. Returns the updated PropChange.

tools.name: snapshot_get
tools.description: List stored project snapshots (same as 'snapshot list'); Live is not contacted. 'snapshot save' reads the set. Optional: notes (default: true), params (default: true). Returns the Snapshot.

tools.name: song_continue
tools.description: Resume playback from where it stopped. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: song_get
tools.description: Read a song property. Required: prop. Returns the PropValue.

tools.name: song_seek
tools.description: Move the playhead to a beat or bar.beat position, or jump by a number of beats. Optional: to, by. Returns the new PropChange.

params.name: to
params.description: Target position as beats (64) or bar.beat (17.1)

params.name: by
params.description: Jump relative to the current position, in beats (negative jumps back)

tools.name: song_set
tools.description: Change a song property (the change is journaled). Required: prop, value. Returns the updated PropChange.

params.name: value
params.description: New value: a number, on/off, or a quantization name such as 1/4

tools.name: song_stop-clips
tools.description: Stop all playing clips, or only one track's clips with --track. Optional: track. Returns the new Ack.

params.name: track
params.description: Only stop clips on this track (name or number)

tools.name: song_tap-tempo
tools.description: Tap the Tap Tempo button once. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: status_get
tools.description: Show tempo, time signature, play state, loop and every track with its mixer state. Returns the SessionStatus.

tools.name: stop_now
tools.description: Stop Live's transport. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: track_arm
tools.description: Arm or disarm a track for recording. Required: track, on. Returns the updated PropChange.

params.name: on
params.description: true to arm, false to disarm

tools.name: track_color
tools.description: Set a track's color from Live's palette (0-69). Required: track, index. Returns the updated PropChange.

tools.name: track_create
tools.description: Create a MIDI, audio or return track. Required: type. Optional: name, index. Returns the new Track.

tools.name: track_delete
tools.description: Delete a track. Required: track. Returns the Ack. Destructive.

tools.name: track_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate a track with its devices and clips. Required: track. Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: track_get
tools.description: Show a track's mixer state, devices and clip slots. Required: track. Returns the TrackDetail.

tools.name: track_meter
tools.description: Current output levels for every track. Returns array of Meter.

tools.name: track_mute
tools.description: Mute or unmute a track. Required: track, on. Returns the updated PropChange.

params.name: on
params.description: true to mute, false to unmute

tools.name: track_pan
tools.description: Set a track's pan from -1 (left) to 1 (right). Required: track, value. Returns the updated PropChange.

tools.name: track_rename
tools.description: Rename a track. Required: track, name. Returns the updated PropChange.

tools.name: track_routing
tools.description: Show a track's input/output routing, the available routes and its monitoring state. Required: track. Returns the Routing.

tools.name: track_send
tools.description: Set a send level (send A = 1) as a 0-1 knob value. Required: track, send, value. Returns the updated PropChange.

tools.name: track_set-routing
tools.description: Change a track's input/output routing or monitoring. Required: track. Optional: input_type, input_channel, output_type (plus 2 more). Returns the updated Routing.

params.name: input_type
params.description: Input routing type, e.g. All Ins

tools.name: track_solo
tools.description: Solo or unsolo a track. Required: track, on. Returns the updated PropChange.

params.name: on
params.description: true to solo, false to unsolo

tools.name: track_volume
tools.description: Set a track's volume as a 0-1 fader value, or in dB (-inf to +6; --db needs AbletonPPExtras). Required: track. Optional: db, fader. Returns the updated PropChange.

tools.name: tracks_list
tools.description: List every track: number, name, type, volume (0-1 fader, plus dB with AbletonPPExtras), pan, mute, solo, arm and sends. Returns array of Track.

tools.name: undo_last
tools.description: Undo the last operation in Live's undo history (includes your own mouse edits). Returns the new Ack.

tools.name: view_get
tools.description: Show the selected track, scene, clip and device. Returns the Selection.

tools.name: view_select
tools.description: Select a track, scene, clip or device. Optional: track, scene, slot (plus 1 more). Returns the updated Selection.

tools.name: view_show
tools.description: Switch Live's main window to the Arrangement view (switching to Session is not supported). Required: view. Returns the updated Ack.

novel_features.name: Safe note rewrite with backups
novel_features.description: Overwrite a clip's MIDI notes from JSON with an automatic backup, and restore any earlier version.

novel_features.name: Load device by name
novel_features.description: Load an instrument or effect onto a track by its browser name, such as Echo or Drift. Needs the browser index (run sync --resources browser once) and the AbletonMCP script.

novel_features.name: Arrangement from scenes
novel_features.description: Lay out a whole song in the Arrangement from Session scenes, with a named locator at each section. Needs the AbletonMCP script.

novel_features.name: Mixer scenes
novel_features.description: Save every track's volume, pan, mute, solo and sends under a name and recall them later.

novel_features.name: Action journal with targeted revert
novel_features.description: See every change this CLI made, with before and after values; roll back specific ones with journal revert.

novel_features.name: Snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Compare two saved project snapshots, or a snapshot against the live set: tracks, mixer, devices, parameters, clips and notes. Reading the live set needs the AbletonMCP script.

novel_features.name: Device chain save and apply
novel_features.description: Save a track's chain of devices with their settings; chain apply rebuilds it on another track (needs the browser index and the AbletonMCP script).
